sloka: रामादपि हि तम् मन्ये धर्मतो बलवत्तरम् ।कथम् द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य वनम् गच्छेति भाषिते ॥२-१२-६२॥
transliteration: rāmādapi hi tam manye dharmato balavattaram ।katham drakṣyāmi rāmasya vanam gaccheti bhāṣite ॥2-12-62॥

translations.english: While instructing Rama to go to the forest, how can I look at his face, pale like the eclipsed moon?
